item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 27/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will continue to bring generally fine and very hot weather to Guangdong tomorrow. Besides, the tropical disturbance now near the Philippines will move towards the northeastern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the disturbance and a southwesterly airstream, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week, but it will still be very hot over inland areas. The subtropical ridge will cover southeastern China again midweek next week, bringing very hot weather to the region.
